definitions.gloss: to send back; to return; to ship back
definitions.explanation: To return something to the sender or original location by sending it. Used for packages, products, documents, and also for escorting someone back.

examples.japanese: {不良品|ふりょうひん}を{送|おく}り{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: I sent back the defective product.

examples.japanese: サイズが{合|あ}わなかったので{送|おく}り{返|かえ}して{交換|こうかん}してもらった。
examples.english: The size didn't fit, so I sent it back and had it exchanged.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{不備|ふび}があったため、{申請者|しんせいしゃ}に{送|おく}り{返|かえ}すことになった。
examples.english: Because there were deficiencies in the documents, they had to be sent back to the applicant.

notes:
Godan verb ({五段|ごだん}). Transitive.

A compound of {送|おく}る (to send) and {返|かえ}す (to return). The {返|かえ}す component adds the meaning of returning to the origin.

ASPECT (ている):
- {送|おく}り{返|かえ}した (sent back — completed)
- {送|おく}り{返|かえ}している (is in the process of sending back)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {返品|へんぴん}する is specifically for returning purchased goods
- {返送|へんそう}する is a more formal/written synonym
- {突|つ}き{返|かえ}す means to refuse and send back (more forceful)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商品|しょうひん}を{送|おく}り{返|かえ}す (to send back a product)
- {着払|ちゃくばら}いで{送|おく}り{返|かえ}す (to send back with recipient paying postage)
- {元|もと}の{場所|ばしょ}に{送|おく}り{返|かえ}す (to send back to the original location)
